jamie-sales: FYI Prospect: Northpoint wants a 10-day POC. Scope: Okta SSO, SCIM user+group sync, RBAC mapping from groups, and domain verification across 4 subdomains (some in different DNS zones). They also sent a 20-page security Q. Need quick answers: SCIM delta vs bulk guidance, SCIM rate limits for POC, how we handle multi-zone domain claims, delegated tenant admin capabilities, and a rough Dedicated POC price. @rachel-se @otto-eng

rachel-se: Quick summary: we support SP-initiated SAML and ingest IdP metadata. SCIM 2.0 supported with bulk import (for initial seed) + PATCH-based delta for changes. For group-heavy orgs prefer SCIM groups to avoid large SAML assertions. We can map SCIM groups to Redwood roles and enforce an allowlist so only designated groups provision roles. Delegated tenant admins can be given tenant-scoped power to manage SSO/SCIM settings and request domain claims (final verification may be gated).

otto-eng: SCIM detail: delta uses PATCH ops and our endpoint returns only changed attributes. For POC we recommend: 1) bulk import with pageSize ~1000, 2) enable delta webhooks. Hosted default throttle is 75 req/s for SCIM endpoints; Dedicated POCs can request a temporary bump. Example minimal PATCH we accept: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}
```

otto-eng: Note: if groups are nested in Okta, Okta may flatten or expand them depending on the app mapping. Recommend they export a sample assertion and a small group list ahead of the kickoff.

sam-ops: Multi-zone domain claims: we produce a TXT token per domain. For subdomains in different zones we need separate TXT verifications. If they run a parent zone and want a consolidated token across child zones we can do an ops-approved consolidation but it requires their DNS admin to allow the record. No wildcard apex verification. Typical verify time is minutes after propagation; plan for up to 24h. We can run verification checks if they grant temporary DNS read access.

jamie-sales: Pricing direction? They prefer Dedicated if price is reasonable.

sam-ops: Two options: Hosted elevated quotas + credits (fastest) or a short Dedicated instance. Ballpark Dedicated POC: $2,800/week for a 10-day trial with increased SCIM throttle and reserved CPU/GPU slices for the window. Exact quote from sales ops.

maria-legal: Security packet checklist: SOC2 summary, pen-test report, encryption+KMS note, data processing addendum, SAML endpoints + attributes we require, SCIM retention policy, and network isolation doc for Dedicated. If they return the questionnaire we'll fill and escalate any clauses that need legal redlines.

jamie-sales: Great. I'll ask them for IdP metadata (XML/URL), a sample SAML assertion, SCIM service token for a test user, the list of domains with hosting zones, and their completed questionnaire. Setting kickoff for next Tue.

calendar-bot: Created event "Northpoint POC kickoff - SSO/SCIM" Tue 10:00 AM (45m) with #sales, @rachel-se, @otto-eng, @maria-legal.

jamie-sales: Thanks all, will update thread when I have the questionnaire back. :thumbsup:
